title: fix(runtime): New similar on a flow with a live override writes the copy instead of answering 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8SvKmnAA4AE3GV4qw7oZyB9)_

Fixes #29650

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:流程「New similar」(克隆)复制定义时,连同保护信封一起丢掉 `overrides` 声明,副本成为配对包自己的条目。
- 为什么改:管理员在 Studio 定制并发布了打包流程后再点 New similar,副本带着原定制的 `overrides` 换了新名字,写入闸门答 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE,什么都没写成。
- 风险与回滚:只多删一个键(从 spec 的 `OverrideDeclarationFields` 派生);回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`(`FLOW_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS`)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts`(新 describe)、`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json`(第 10 步与 acceptance[6])。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts`,预期 19/19 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `FLOW_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`) now spreads `Object.keys(OverrideDeclarationFields)` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`, derived the same way the protection envelope already is, so a clone never carries `overrides`. The docblock says why: a declaration names the base item it replaces by name, so under the copy's new name it would declare an override of a flow the base does not ship (ADR-0146 D2), and New similar writes the pair's own item (D4).
- **What the copy is copied from, as the code serves it.** The door reads its source with `automationService.getFlow(name)`, the engine's flow map entry for the name. With a published override that entry is the override's body, armed in place of the base (ADR-0146 D9 item 1, `resolveFlowPrecedence`). So the copy carries the override's definition, minus the declaration, which is what the card asks for. If a reviewer reads that differently, say so on the PR. The stored-row binding the protocol stamps on a hydrated body is a symbol-keyed property, which `structuredClone` does not copy, so nothing else from the pair's row reaches the copy.
- QA case `automation.package-flow-override`, revision 3: a new step 10 customizes and publishes again, then presses New similar while the override is live. The new acceptance[6] says that answers 200 into the pair, with the override's edits, status `obsolete` and no `overrides` key, and that the source still serves the override. Appended rather than inserted, so the existing step and acceptance indices that other text cites do not move. `automated` names the new pin.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime` patch.

## Why

An administrator who customized a packaged flow and wanted a second variant got an English sentence about a declaration they never wrote, and the only way through was to delete their customization first. The card measured it live on `main`. This PR reproduces the same refusal at the clone door over the real metadata protocol and store.

## Tests

- New describe `[#29650, ADR-0146 D2/D4] New similar while the source's override is live` in `automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts`. It uses the existing real-stack rig (better-sqlite3, the real `ObjectQL`, a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). It ensures the pair, saves the override into it declaring `overrides: { package, basedOn }`, arms it in the engine map, and then drives `POST /automation/:name/clone` through `HttpDispatcher`. It has two cases: the copy answers 200 into the pair with no `overrides` on the answer, the stored row or the registered body; and the copy carries the override's definition while the override row and the armed body stay as they were.
- Control: the no-override cases already in the same file (`ensures the pair through the ensure door…`) stay at 200.

## Acceptance notes

- The order's Clause-② (no) and Metadata-protocol (none) hold on the diff: no `packages/spec/**`, no `packages/metadata-protocol/**`, no wire shape changed. `OverrideDeclarationFields` was already exported from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`.
- Section order follows the os-dev order, with the repository template's `Why` heading folded in. The template's Human Minimum checklist is not repeated here.
